method: Actual web open of two primary Xbox Game Dev guidelines; source statements kept distinct from project choices; no competitor full playtest or certification

sources.title: Xbox Accessibility Guideline112: UI navigation
sources.observed: Consistent screen/component order, interaction mechanisms and predictable focus support clear game navigation.
sources.application: Use the same return semantics for read-only inventory sale and medicine inspection; retain local draft across ordinary details.
sources.notPrescribed: No mandated specific four-item grid, finite budget, timer or Vue lifecycle.

sources.title: Xbox Accessibility Guideline114: UI context
sources.observed: Players should understand a screen and what a control will do; context and labels must explain changes and expected input.
sources.application: Expose finite order/dose limits before explicit start, distinguish editing/reading from execution, and provide full original strategy after an enemy is gone.
sources.notPrescribed: The project derives progressive disclosure and read-only strategy pages; the guideline is not approval of our timing, balance or final layout.
